After the AHV 21 reform, which came into effect on **1 January 2024**, the standard retirement age for both men and women in Switzerland has been unified.

They now receive the AHV pension at the age of **65**.

Prior to AHV 21, women retired at age 64 while men retired at age 65. The reform equalized the retirement age for both genders to promote gender equality and address demographic challenges, such as an aging population and increasing life expectancy.
